# Recorded model sources

`devnet.json` preserves raw gateway JSON and MCP tool text with each public URL and response time. The model CLI records it with `--record`. All calls are read-only. MCP requests use the shared client.

Discovery requests `max_results: 1000`. Details and pricing request each catalogue id or registry hash. Comparison requests those ids with `tokens_estimate: 1000`. No filters are applied to providers or the trust root.
